definitions.explanation: Meeting someone again after a period of separation. Carries an emotional nuance of being reunited with someone missed.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}と{再会|さいかい}した。
10{年|ねん}ぶりの{再会|さいかい}に{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: Tears came at the reunion after ten years.

examples.japanese: いつかまた{再会|さいかい}できることを{願|ねが}っている。
examples.english: I hope we can meet again someday.

notes:
Implies an emotional significance to the meeting — not just bumping into someone again, but being genuinely reunited. Often used with ～ぶり (after a gap of...) to emphasize the length of separation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{再会|さいかい}を{果|は}たす (achieve a reunion)
・{再会|さいかい}を{喜|よろこ}ぶ (be happy about a reunion)
・{感動|かんどう}の{再会|さいかい} (moving reunion)
・～ぶりの{再会|さいかい} (reunion after [a period])

DISTINCTIONS:
・{再会|さいかい}: meeting a person again (emotional, after separation)
・{再開|さいかい}: resumption, reopening (restarting an activity or operation — different kanji, same reading)

cross_references.notes: 再開 (さいかい) means resumption/reopening — different kanji, same reading
